title: cardamine nasturtium-aquaticum
intro: Cardamine nasturtium-aquaticum, commonly known as watercress, is an aquatic or semi-aquatic perennial plant that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. The health benefits of watercress include its high nutritional value, rich in vitamins A, C, and K, as well as minerals like calcium and iron, which can help boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and support overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of watercress include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in treating various health conditions such as digestive issues, arthritis, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of watercress include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and carotenoids, which have been shown to exhibit potent antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
